title: AURA V-Cycle Phase Mapping
description: Maps ASPICE V-cycle phases to AURA resources for the Copilot Ecosystem Explorer (CEE) VS Code extension. Used as a placeholder/override layer on top of resource front-matter metadata.

PhaseEntry.description: Describes one ASPICE phase and the AURA resources recommended for it.

aspiceProcess.description: Full ASPICE process name (e.g. 'Software Unit Verification').

displayName.description: Short human-readable label for the phase shown in the UI.

roles.description: Engineering roles responsible for or involved in this phase.

workProducts.description: ASPICE work products produced or consumed in this phase.

resources.description: AURA resource IDs to associate with this phase. Format: 'type:source:name' (e.g. 'agent:aura:embedded-c-reviewer', 'skill:aura:cmake-build-helper').

items.description: Resource ID in the format type:source:name
